description: Lutry is its own municipality on Lake Geneva, east of Lausanne, with a small port, a church, and old houses under the Lavaux vines. In late September the vineyard leaves are turning yellow and gold. This is the town and the port, not the terrace view above Rivaz. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 20°C, with a fresh breeze and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
